translations.web: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for a wave-offering unto Jehovah.
